family.description: This domain is found towards the N terminus of yeast NAD-specific glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH2, also known as DHE2) and similar fungal proteins. GDH2 is involved in the degradation of glutamate to ammonia and alpha-ketoglutarate. This domain is predicted to adopt a globular structure composed of four alpha-helices.
family.name: NAD-dependent glutamate dehydrogenase, N-terminal domain
